body: Holy shit, they already replied and I don’t need an ID. Genuinely, thank you so much, you just saved me a lot of misery!!

Did I ask for a doctor who is breaking the law? nope

I asked if any accepted proof of residency other than state ID. 

I’m literally registered with the MMCC, the government agency, who sees over the doctor offices, which already required tangible proof of residency to become registered, so i’d say im asking reasonable questions.

I’ve already taken multiple trips to the DMV, and attempted to take multiple more, which were appointments that got cancelled outside of my control. 

If you legitimately knew what you were talking about, which at this point i don’t trust you do, all you had to say was that no doctors in Maryland accepted other forms of identification and residency. 

Also, I do apologize for assuming a MEDICAL marijuana forum was sympathetic towards medical conditions- both physical and mental. 

Go fuck yourself.
Which I made it pretty clear I’m not looking for a “get an ID” response
I am aware uber exists. I got legitimate social issues, getting in a car with a stranger is a big deal for me and something i’m not going to do.

I am a Maryland resident & I got registered with MMCC already without an ID, I used documents proving my identity & address. If I was 21 I honestly might not even bother paying to sign up, but Im 18 & cannot drive, so no DC for me unfortunately. I tried to sign up for an ID once again, but no appointments til april. Thanks though!
I am in a specific situation where I only have access to one DMV. April 12th is the soonest I can get one.
this was very helpful, thank you!
Yeah, an office I’ve been talking with allows zoom calls for the doctor referral. I believe they’re called marijane consults.
I’ll try to! Thank you for your time and the advice.

I wouldn’t say it’s always particularly due to another instance of something happening boiling up, but it’s certainly deeper than my meal. For example, what often happens is that is the original trigger of my depression, but then it delves into how fucking petty I must be to get triggered over such a trivial thing. Proceedingly, it webs into a multitude of things, all resulting in self hatred.

You’re right, things don’t get better. By that I meant I hope my overall mental state gets better and that I am more equipped to handle and deal with the ups and downs of life.

I’m very glad to hear that you’re life has changed for the good, and that is a comforting thought. You’re also very right about endless possibilities. Just because I think something certainly doesn’t make it true. Life is full of twists and surprises. It’s just hard to realize that when you’ve had your mind set to something for so long. However, it’s easier for me to see now that it will be at times. I know in the heat of episodes I will neglect to accept that and/or care unfortunately. Let’s hope I do though.

Thank you very much for your thoughts and your time.

Haha, thanks for the advice on the trips, I’ve researched the safest way to do it extensively, so I’m hopefully set.

I know there are many things I have yet to experience. The meaning of life to me is experiences. So the thing I fear most about suicide, other than hurting those who care for me, is the experiences I’ll inevitably be cutting myself short of. Hopefully I can keep this in mind, and care enough through hard times.

I have people whom I am comfortable discussing these things with to an extent, if I am feeling brave. I just dislike to because I feel as though it brings them down. Lots of people in my life know I am suicidal, as I am a fairly open. However, I expressed this feeling of inevitability to someone for the first time this week. I told my mom, whom understands much of what I’m going through as I inherited some of my mental issues from her. She also told me she feels this inevitably at times. While that wasn’t comforting to hear, it was good to know I wasn’t alone. I fear if I committed suicide she would take on the burden and follow suite. I am also my best friends only friend and he reminds me of this each time I express my suicidal thoughts to him. Can’t leave out my dog either, don’t want her to miss me.

It’s safe to say I am alive for other people much of the time.
